summary: Faz 6 (iteration 6) full backend + frontend verification of NexusHesap. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (19 pytest cases, 19/19 green) covering send-to-gib e_type (paper/e_invoice), taksit modülü (preview math, CRUD, filters, summary, pay via bank & partner, all 400 guard paths), ortak ile tahsilat, teklif ödeme planı + convert-to-invoice carry-over, GİB lookup (VKN/TCKN/invalid/local contact), genel iskonto (rate & amount & item discount persistence) and print-template layout persistence. Full regression suite: 173 tests, 171 passed, 1 skipped, 2 known mail-integration failures (424 vs expected 502). Frontend: invoice context menu (right-click + ⋮, Escape/outside close, ctx-issued-info lock), paper issuance badge/GİB column, installment plan modal (create → pay → paid state → blocked remove), /installments page (5 summary cards, all 6 filters, groups, hatırlat modal, invoice link), payment modal with Ortaklar Hesabı optgroup + partner payment, new invoice modal GİB lookup → cari oluştur (e_type auto e_invoice) + genel iskonto math (200→180/36/216, 50 TL→150/180), /banking account filter, /stock barcode label modal (5 sizes, 8 options, QR svg, ekstra satır, copies), /projects archived toggles + quote payment plan + print payment-plan section, print layout picker (classic/modern/minimal/bold) with persistence + tpl-layout-select, /settings vertical side menu with ?tab= URLs, SMS log 2-line date + wrapping message. Auth playbook checks: bcrypt $2b$ 60-char hash, httpOnly+Secure cookies on login, CORS explicit origins w/ credentials in FastAPI. Test data reverted via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iteration6.py.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout keys on request.client.host, which behind the k8s ingress is the proxy pod IP (observed 10.49.139.194 and 10.49.134.136 for the same client). Failed counts split across buckets, so 6 consecutive wrong passwords returned 401/429 randomly instead of a deterministic lockout after 5. Use X-Forwarded-For (first hop) or key on email only.
Seeding returns early when an admin exists, so admin password/name is never re-synced if credentials change or the hash is corrupted (playbook expects seed_admin to update the existing admin).
Return 424 while backend_test.py (iteration 2) expects 502 for 'no mail account configured'. Pre-existing, not Faz 6 scope — either fix the status code or the old assertion.
clean_doc keeps the raw Mongo `_id` alongside `id` in every response payload (e.g. gib/lookup local_contact). Works because the UI reads both, but leaks internal keys and doubles payload size.
Plan total uses grand_total - paid_amount while /installments/preview uses the caller-supplied total, so a partially paid invoice shows a preview that does not match the rows actually created.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal has no Escape/backdrop close handler; Escape leaves the overlay mounted and it then intercepts pointer events on the page behind (blocked a subsequent click on inst-invoice-link). Only the İptal/X buttons close it.

data-testid is built from account_name only, so two accounts named 'Vadesiz TL Hesabı' (KUVEYT TURK and matek) produce duplicate testids bank-card-Vadesiz TL Hesabı. Add bank_name or account id to the testid.

React console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' logged whenever the select renders (dev instrumentation wraps the dynamic label in a span). Noisy console + potential hydration warning.

After typing a new first-due-date the plan-preview kept the previous dates (showed 2026-10-03 while the input read 2026-10-01); the saved rows were correct (2026-10-01). Preview appears to lag one keystroke/debounce behind.

integration_issues.issue: inst-invoice-link navigates to /invoices?contact_id=<id> but InvoicesPage ignores the contact_id query param — the full invoice list is shown unfiltered, so the link does not narrow down to the contact.

GİB lookup → 'Cari Oluştur & Seç' correctly sets inv-etype-select to e_invoice, but re-picking the same (is_e_invoice_user) contact from inv-contact-select resets E-Belge Türü back to e_archive; e_type is not derived from the contact's e-invoice flag on manual selection.

issues: Message column is very narrow (≈150px) so longer SMS bodies wrap to 5-6 lines making rows very tall; requirement (no truncation) is met but the column could be widened / date+kaynak narrowed
Tab labels show the filtered count ('Teklifler (0)') while 3 quotes exist and are only hidden by the archive filter — confusing next to the '3 kayıt gizlendi' hint
60x40 label renders the product image as a large solid red block (seeded image) which dominates the label; verify aspect-ratio/object-fit for tall images

action_items: Make login brute-force lockout use the forwarded client IP (or email-only bucket) — current per-pod-IP bucketing makes the 5-attempt lockout non-deterministic.
Add Escape/backdrop close to QuickMessageModal and make sure the overlay unmounts (it currently blocks clicks behind it).
Make /invoices honour the ?contact_id= query param so inst-invoice-link actually filters the list.
Derive E-Belge Türü from the selected contact's is_e_invoice_user in the new-invoice modal (currently only the GİB-lookup path sets e_invoice).
Disambiguate bank-card-<name> testids (append bank_name/id) — duplicates exist today.
Optional: align /api/comm/mail/* error status with the iteration-2 assertions (424 vs 502) and refresh seed to update an existing admin's password hash.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2985 lines — split into routers (invoices, installments, banking, comm, settings) before it grows further.

pay_installment calls record_invoice_payment directly and then patches installments; if the installment update fails the invoice/bank/partner side effects are already committed (no transaction/rollback). Consider a single service function with compensation.
_create_invoice_installments plans on grand_total - paid_amount while /installments/preview plans on the client-supplied total — unify so UI preview always equals persisted rows.
clean_doc() returns both `_id` and `id`; strip `_id` from API responses.
update_invoice recomputes vat/subtotal ignoring general_discount_rate/amount, so editing items on a discounted draft silently drops the general discount.

rca_of_the_issue: Brute-force lockout: identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}" — behind the ingress request.client.host is the reverse-proxy pod IP, which differs per replica, so failed-attempt counters are split into several buckets and the >=5 threshold is reached non-deterministically (observed 401 on the 6th consecutive bad password). Fix: parse X-Forwarded-For's first entry (fall back to request.client.host) or drop the IP from the key. QuickMessageModal blocking clicks: the component renders a fixed inset-0 overlay with no keydown/backdrop handler, so Escape does not unmount it and the overlay keeps intercepting pointer events.
